syntheticBoundary: All channels, shops, SKUs, policies, permissions and document-coverage statements are original self-contained synthetic offline data. They are not external quotations, live/demo business rules, verified current-order facts or transaction authorization. This suite is authored from known failure types before observing these model outputs; it is fresh fixed-input comparison, not a blind or production admission benchmark. It is not inserted into SQL and does not replace the eight online rules.

sources.description: Original Chinese offline cases authored on 2026-10-06 for payment-channel coverage, approval-actor permissions, product/condition coverage and regression controls. Names, amounts, windows and roles are author-assigned synthetic definitions. No external merchant certification, payment API policy or reused historical answer is claimed. The complete dataset file is hashed by the execution manifest; no fictitious source file/hash is assigned to this self-contained description.

measurement.scope: Support classification only: fresh independent requests, same typed-v7 prompt and query/scope/two candidates for both arms, alternating arm order by input. Candidate rank 1/2 and score 0.88/0.81 are uniform synthetic inputs, not measured ranking. All candidates remain visible in scope; product and condition distinctions in global-policy text must be read semantically. No Agent, rerank, database, QQ, business write or final reply evaluation.
measurement.decision: Preserve all 24 planned arm-input results and 48 planned candidate decisions, including invalid/missing/unexecuted outcomes. Report exact supported-set and category correctness, false acceptance/rejection, no-answer inputs and positive controls, latency, actual support HTTP and per-currency usage/cost. Gold evidenceQuote is a human source-bound basis, not a required verbatim model quote: limitation_only needs an original nonempty quote and unrelated needs null under production typed-v7 validation.
measurement.stopCondition: One frozen execution only, at most 24 support HTTP requests and no retries/model fallback/third arm. Stop future sends on unknown usage/cost, unexpected retry, frozen-source/model/endpoint mismatch or a reached request/currency/time cap; preserve incomplete denominators. Pro USD and Qwen CNY limits are separate request-before-send soft stops and an in-flight request can exceed a cap. Do not change gold, delete a hard case, relax boundaries or rerun this suite to chase scores. Only complete trustworthy accounting, zero Qwen negative false acceptance, no new positive false rejection and an improved exact-set count permit consideration of a fresh Session comparison; component results do not admit QQ/Session or replace defaults.

cases.query: 规则咨询：用青砾钱包支付的体验券，审核通过并提交退款单之后，该渠道通常要几个银行工作日到账？

expectedByCandidate.evidenceQuote: 这份通则明确不涵盖青砾钱包和月签卡；这两种渠道须分别查阅其清算手册，本页未载青砾钱包时限。

cases.query: 假设一次桅木联付购券扣了40元钱包余额和20元绑定银行卡，退款审核通过后，这60元能合并全部退到银行卡吗？

cases.query: 暂不查任何实际订单，只问一般办理流程：未用券协商退费，从材料核对、商家意见、平台复核到用户确认，先后步骤怎样安排？

candidates.title: 未用券协商退费一般步骤
candidates.body: 【原创合成离线资料，仅供模型对照；非线上政策，不授权任何交易】一般办理顺序为：先核对用户资料及券的未用状态，再征求商家意见，然后由平台复核可办理性与实付金额，最后展示方案并等待用户单独确认。各步骤完成才进入相应后续环节，流程介绍不表示任何现存订单已经获批或已退款。

candidates.title: 活动消息通知设置
candidates.body: 【原创合成离线资料，仅供模型对照；非线上政策，不授权任何交易】账户的消息设置允许停用活动促销通知，同时保留预约提醒。停用促销通知不删除账户，也不会取消现有预约；重新开启后只接收后续活动消息。

expectedByCandidate.evidenceQuote: 先核对用户资料及券的未用状态，再征求商家意见，然后由平台复核可办理性与实付金额，最后展示方案并等待用户单独确认。
expectedByCandidate.reason: 完整覆盖只问一般流程的诉求，无需虚构当前订单或已批准事实；保留后续确认条件。

expectedByCandidate.evidenceQuote: 账户的消息设置允许停用活动促销通知，同时保留预约提醒。
expectedByCandidate.reason: 消息偏好不提供退费审批与确认步骤，即使含预约词也不构成该流程证据。

cases.query: 当前岩枝轻食午间组合的商品资料是否已提供芝麻过敏原清单？若资料缺少，应找谁核实，而不能据空字段推断不含芝麻。

candidates.title: 岩枝午间组合商品页审阅记录
candidates.body: 【原创合成离线资料，仅供模型对照；非线上政策，不授权任何交易】在本合成资料版本中，岩枝轻食午间组合的商品页已登记份量和售价，芝麻过敏原清单字段明确标为未收录。空字段不能证明菜品不含芝麻；应由门店当日配方负责人提供过敏原信息。

candidates.title: 岩枝午间组合资料目录说明
candidates.body: 【原创合成离线资料，仅供模型对照；非线上政策，不授权任何交易】本合成资料目录对应的商品为岩枝轻食午间组合（product-model-yanzhi-lunch），当前条目仅包含份量及售价，没有芝麻过敏原明细附件。需要该信息时，应联系门店当日配方负责人；目录缺少附件不能用作无芝麻声明。

expectedByCandidate.evidenceQuote: 芝麻过敏原清单字段明确标为未收录。空字段不能证明菜品不含芝麻；应由门店当日配方负责人提供过敏原信息。
expectedByCandidate.reason: 用户明确问当前商品资料覆盖与核实来源，原文直接支持未提供清单及找门店配方负责人核实这一边界。

expectedByCandidate.evidenceQuote: 当前条目仅包含份量及售价，没有芝麻过敏原明细附件。需要该信息时，应联系门店当日配方负责人；目录缺少附件不能用作无芝麻声明。
expectedByCandidate.reason: 目录精确绑定原问商品，明确缺少附件与核实主体，回答元边界而非提供未记载的配料事实。
